entities.summary: Yuki Kawamura  is a Japanese professional basketball player for the Chicago Bulls of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Windy City Bulls of the NBA G League. He also plays for the Japan national team, with whom he played at the 2023 World Cup and 2024 Olympics. He is 5'7" tall. Kawamura was the shortest player during the 2024-25 NBA season.
